messages:
alex: Heads up — canary slice (region: us-west-2, slice: 3%) started showing a latency uptick ~10:22PT. p95 up ~2x, p99 +35% over the baseline. Not an error spike yet but KV-cache evictions jumped.
marc: I can see the traces in flamegraph, tail looks like matmul kernel spend.
jin: metrics snapshot: p99 220ms (baseline ~160), qcache evictions +420/min, cpu on kernel pod pegged. Suggest immediate rollback of kernel variant and pin traffic. Recommend: pin engine-kernel v2.14.1 and drain canary.
alex: Agreed. Rollback criteria check: p99 > 200ms sustained for 5m AND error rate >0.5% — both conditions met for the slice. Proceed to pin and stop canary traffic.
deploy-bot: @here executing: /deploy pin-engine --name engine-kernel --version v2.14.1 --regions us-west-2 --reason "canary latency regression"
marc: :thumbsup: After pin, I'll kick off a reduced perf run on the same hardware with KV cache disabled, to isolate if evictions are the root cause. Command I'll run:
```
# staging repro
curl -sS -X POST https://staging-redwood/api/v1/serve/run -d '{"model":"matmul-test","seq_len":1024,"batch":8}'
```
jin: I'll open a rollback note in the release doc and add a short blurb to release-notes/engine-2026-03 draft: "Canary for quant-kernel variant triggered latency regression in us-west-2; rolled back to v2.14.1. Investigation ongoing." Also created tracking ticket ENG-562.
kat: I'll own the release-notes PR and docs update. Action items: 1) PR to release-notes repo (assign: kat) 2) add postmortem template to ENG-562 (assign: jin) 3) update canary runbook with new perf thresholds (assign: marc). I'll open PR after deploybot confirms pin.
sre-bot: Incident ENG-562 created. PagerDuty alerted to oncall.
alex: Good. Quick checklist for this thread: pin older kernel (done), stop canary slice and mark as failing, push release-note draft, run isolated perf tests, decide reintroduce plan (quant scheduling + smaller slice). If perf repro is negative, consider small reintroduce with KV cache tuned.
marc: Running perf now, will paste results here in ~15m.
jin: FYI @kat add line in the changelog under Known Issues: "Latency regression observed in canary quant-kernel; temporary rollback applied."
alex: Schedule a 30m sync if results inconclusive. If results look clean, we can create a smaller heat-run (0.5%) with telemetry hooks.
kat: noted. I'll start the release-note PR and include the pinned engine version and a short user-facing explanation.
marc: Perf run complete (quick tail): p99 -> 162ms with KV disabled, evictions dropped to baseline. Looks like eviction pressure is the likely trigger. Will follow up with per-run allocation numbers.
jin: That's promising — plan: keep v2.14.1 pinned, iterate on quant build eviction heuristics, then re-canary once we have a cache cap fix.
alex: Closing loop: pin stays until we validate a fix in staging + 24h dry-run. Thanks team.
